hints.title: Character Frequency Balance
hints.text: To make two strings anagrams by appending characters, both strings must end up with identical counts for each letter.

hints.title: Independent Discrepancies
hints.text: For each character, the difference in frequencies between s and t must be appended to the string that lacks them.

hints.title: Sum Absolute Differences
hints.text: Sum abs(count_s[c] - count_t[c]) over all 26 lowercase English letters.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating permutations or matching characters individually takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 26-bucket counting calculates symmetric discrepancy in linear time with constant memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sum absolute count differences across the 26 lowercase alphabet.

solutions.approach: C++ single array net delta summation.
Java int array frequency delta sum.
